description: This file defines an interface class 'IGstWebAudioPlayerPrivate' for a GStreamer Web Audio Player component, including method declarations for changing pipeline state and stopping a worker thread, within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace.

classes.name: IGstWebAudioPlayerPrivate
classes.description: An interface class for a GStreamer Web Audio Player, providing methods to change pipeline state and stop worker thread.

methods.name: changePipelineState
methods.description: Changes the state of the GStreamer pipeline to the specified new state.

methods.name: stopWorkerThread
methods.description: Stops the worker thread associated with the audio player.
